blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court on Thursday put the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) witness back at the front of the prosecution lineup, abandoning a plan to first hear a financial expert after senator-judges questioned the last-minute change. BIR Office of the Commissioner chief of staff, lawyer Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez, had been scheduled to testify on tax records relevant to Article II of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment case. The prosecution instead proposed presenting lawyer and certified public accountant Alexander Cabrera, chairperson emeritus of PwC Philippines, after prosecution lawyer Erwin Matib, who was assigned to handle Garcia-Marquez’s testimony, fell […]...
